parameters.prompt: Create exactly ONE full-body transparent PNG game sprite, native square at least 1024x1024. HIS RIGHT hand holds bronze/teal yin-yang cauldron, HIS LEFT hand glass green potion bottle; back herbal basket with ivory scrolls, berries, green herbs and tassels. Keep equipment and head sizes, camera, perspective, character scale, no redesign. Bright polished hand-painted chibi volume. All head, boots and equipment fit in transparent margins, character height 84% square, ground contact baseline y=92%. True transparent alpha background, no colored outline, no ground/shadow/effect/text/grid. Single walking pose, not a sheet, no extra limbs. Both legs must be newly drawn for the specified biomechanical phase. Pelvis fixed over support zone, small natural stride with no running or floating. Direction W: EXACT LEFT SIDE PROFILE, nose points horizontally left, one eye visible, no front or rear three-quarter angle. Near visible arm is HIS LEFT hand with potion bottle; far HIS RIGHT hand with cauldron reaches forward screen-left behind/above potion arm with natural overlap, never swap their hands. Basket on his back at screen-right.  Walking phase 06 FAR RIGHT ADVANCING SWING. FAR RIGHT leg is BEHIND this near left thigh and swings forward to screen-left: bent right knee narrowly emerges in front, small shaded RIGHT boot at x40%, sole y87%, lifted clearly above ground, pointing left. Right boot is 20 percent smaller than near left boot. Do not make a large foreground forward thigh; near foreground LEFT thigh MUST lead down to the grounded screen-right boot, while the smaller lifted screen-left boot is FAR RIGHT. Preserve body/camera/equipment scale from fixed standing reference. One complete newly drawn pose.
